question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: While passing a chemist’s shop, Rosamond noticed some colourful jars and was especially attracted to a (a) ------- one. She asked her mother to buy it, saying she would use it as a flower pot. But her mother reminded her that the jar was not meant for that (b) -------. Suddenly, Rosamond felt pain in her foot and discovered a (c) ------- in her shoe. She asked her mother to buy her a new pair of shoes. However, her mother said that she didn’t have enough (d) ------- to buy both the shoes and the jar. Rosamond had to make a choice. Although she needed new shoes, her (e) ------- was still drawn to the beautiful jar, and she began debating which one to choose. Ans. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) purple; (b) purpose; (c) hole; (d) money; (e) heart. ● st ●
